added.summary: The built-in UI speaks Simplified Chinese: every engine component and screen string table (`x.en.ogt`) ships a `x.zh-CN.ogt` beside it, bundled with it and registered as a translation of the English base, so under zh-CN PauseScreen reads 已暂停 / 继续游戏. A game's own zh-CN table still overrides any of its keys, and its base table stays the one every locale falls back to.
